---
name: Bug report
about: Report reproducible incorrect behaviour
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
---

## Environment

Browser and version, operating system, and how RecordMint is deployed.

## Capture details

If this involves recording: capture source (screen, window or tab), whether camera and microphone were on, whether audio was expected, and roughly how long the recording ran.

Skip this section if the issue has nothing to do with recording.

## Expected behaviour

## Actual behaviour

## Reproduction

Steps from a clean checkout or a clean browser profile.

## Evidence

Console output, network errors, and what the recording state showed.

**Never include a real token, connection string, key or presigned URL** — a presigned URL is a credential, and it plays the video for anyone who has it.
